outlook.watchFor: A named storm tracking up the Atlantic, even one that never comes near land, sends long-period groundswell here two to four days ahead of itself. That is what turns an ordinary two-foot week into the best surf of the year.
outlook.tideNote: Low tides slide about 50 minutes later each day, which moves the best window with them.
